description: Source-derived census of exported ABI symbols with a call-graph witness to a resolver/delegate primitive for the same host symbol.

call_resolution.local_bindings: Function parameters and let-bound values shadow module items and are never treated as call-graph edges.
call_resolution.qualified: Resolve crate/self/super or scanned-module paths only to one exact module-qualified function.
call_resolution.unknown: Only ambiguous edges reachable from an exported ABI function and capable of hiding same-symbol host delegation are emitted; bare nonlocal names are never guessed.
call_resolution.unqualified: Resolve only to one function with the same name in the caller's module.

policy.profile_evidence: Each release profile applies Rust cfg/cfg_attr predicates before finding every reachable terminal resolver or libc extern call. Admission fails closed on host dependencies, unknown call edges, cfg diagnostics, or incomplete support-matrix coverage.
policy.status_derivation: A row is emitted only when the exported symbol reaches terminal host evidence naming that same symbol; unrelated runtime dependencies cannot force WrapsHostLibc.
